claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Prednisolone hemisuccinate is a glucocorticoid receptor agonist that at 2.5 uM is expected to produce little or no direct cytotoxicity in a 5-day pooled viability screen, since glucocorticoids act mainly cytostatically and pro-apoptotically only in lymphoid malignancies at higher concentrations and over longer exposures.
